Job Description – Forward Deployed Engineer – Language Models



Location: San Francisco, CA (on-site, 5 days a week, in our San Francisco office)

Or 
Melbourne, Australia (on-site, 3 days a week, in our Melbourne office)



About Artificial Analysis

Artificial Analysis is the leading independent AI benchmarking company. We support labs, engineers and enterprises to understand AI capabilities and make critical decisions about their AI strategies. We are the go-to authority for understanding AI, from AI labs and enterprises to media, investors, and policymakers. Our benchmarks don’t just measure the cutting edge of AI, they are actively shaping the frontier.



Our benchmarks and analysis are trusted by hundreds of thousands of users and are the go-to reference for leading AI labs including OpenAI, Google, Meta, NVIDIA and Anthropic, and major publications including the Wall Street Journal, Bloomberg, the Financial Times and The Economist.



We're a fast-growing team backed by Nat Friedman (GitHub, Meta), Daniel Gross (SSI, Meta), Andrew Ng (Google Brain, DeepLearning.ai http://DeepLearning.ai, Amazon), Adam D’Angelo (Quora, Poe, OpenAI), Clem Delangue (Hugging Face) and other industry leaders.



The Opportunity

Artificial Analysis maintains one of the most comprehensive language model benchmarking suites in the industry. The leading AI labs use our results to understand how their models perform, where they fall short, and how they compare to the frontier.

We’re hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to own technical delivery of that work and be the expert our lab partners turn to. You’ll take new models from early access through to validated, published results and investigate what is driving their performance. You’ll work directly with research and engineering teams at the labs as their technical point of contact, on everything from endpoint issues to methodology to what a result means.

Doing this well means becoming an expert in language model evaluation, and we’ll expect you to. You’ll work closely with our eval research team on benchmarks, how results are communicated, and the future roadmap, and you’ll bring what you learn in the field back into our platform and the wider business. The role suits an engineer who wants to own outcomes end-to-end, go deep on how frontier models behave, and help shape what the industry measures next.



What You’ll Do

 - Own technical delivery across multiple AI lab partnerships, from first access to a new model through to published results

 - Act as the expert technical point of contact for research and engineering teams at the leading labs, building trusted relationships with their technical leads

 - Work closely with the eval research team on benchmarks, communication, and roadmap, feeding back what you hear from labs

 - Investigate and monitor benchmarking results, guiding partners on what drives a score and where their models are strong or weak

 - Build deep expertise in language model evals and contribute it elsewhere across the business. This includes contributing to our Python-based benchmarking platform, shipping fixes and building reusable tooling, agents and playbooks

 - Stay current with new model releases, API changes, and developments across the language model ecosystem



What We’re Looking For

Required:

 - 3+ years of experience in a client-facing technical role - solutions engineering, support engineering, technical consulting, or similar (companies like Stripe, Vercel, Cloudflare, Datadog, Palantir, Accenture, or comparable)

 - Strong Python proficiency and comfort working with complex codebases you didn’t write

 - Hands-on experience working with AI/ML model APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, etc.)

 - Excellent debugging skills; you can trace issues across APIs, data pipelines, and code

 - Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts and results clearly to research and engineering teams

 - Highly responsive and reliable; you take ownership of partner issues and follow through

 - You want to own outcomes end-to-end, and you take pride in delivering results that are accurate, reliable and on time

 - High attention to detail and calm under pressure
   
   

Nice to have (not required):

 - Experience with AI evaluation, benchmarking, or testing methodologies

 - Familiarity with LLM inference infrastructure (tokenization, latency measurement, throughput metrics)

 - Interest in going deep on how frontier models behave and how they’re evaluated.

 - Experience working in or with AI labs or model providers

 - Background in B2B SaaS or developer tools



Why Artificial Analysis?

 - Shape how AI gets built: The leading AI labs track our benchmarks and use them to guide their development priorities. Your work will directly influence the direction of AI.

 - Become a world expert in AI: You will evaluate every major model, across every major capability, as they are released, working alongside our eval research team. Very few roles offer this breadth of exposure to frontier AI.

 - Work with the most important players in AI: You’ll be the trusted technical contact for research and engineering teams at the leading AI labs and major enterprises, as an independent voice in the industry.

 - Join at a defining moment: We’re a fast-growing team, backed by some of the most connected investors in AI. The people who join now will shape the product, the team, and the strategy as we scale.

 - Competitive compensation including equity
